# bintables/shl

> << : `shl`, by a constant or by cl.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/shl.pkg) · translates [std/shl](../std/shl.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right is int`

```nasm
{left}
shl rax, {right.value}
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
mov rcx, rbx
shl rax, cl
```

Includes: [bintables/binop](binop.md)
